title: ContractJson
description: .contract.json — the schema registry paired (by basename) with a .feat spec (GAP-S04). Holds JSON Schemas referenced from predictions via `with <Name>`. Shapes live here; behavior lives in the .feat file.

specId.description: Must match the paired .feat file's spec ID.

schemas.description: Named schemas: each value is a JSON Schema or a $ref to one. Resolved at compile time by the schema adapter (GAP-S10) and inlined into generated tests (ADR-0001).
